'''Lona-Ru''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] merchant living during the [[Galactic War]] in [[Mos Ila]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lona-Ru appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a crew skill vendor on Tatooine.
